name: Soviet Union
startIntroPart1: The proletariat, having seized power from the Whites, now establishes the glorious Union of Soviet Socialist Republics under the command of Joseph Stalin.
startIntroPart2: The largest communist nation now projects its influence globally to compete with American capitalism. Will you be able to win the Cold War and prove that communism is the superior ideology?
declaringWar: We must liberate your people, since you did not do so. We will bring the revolution to your nation!
attacked: So this is the freedom you defend so strongly? Very well, we shall show our power.
defeated: The country dies, the proletariat shall never succumb.
introduction: Greetings, comrade. I am Joseph Stalin, representative of the Soviet proletariat.
neutralHello: What would you like to discuss?
tradeRequest: We believe in a fair market. Will you honor this commercial pact?
denounced: Your accusations run counter to the will of the world's workers.
declaringfriendship: Comrade, we must show the international community our comradeship!
